book.title: Women Who Love Too Much: When You Keep Wishing and Hoping He'll Change
book.description: This text is suitable for the reader for whom being in love means being in pain. Therapist Robin Norwood describes loving too much as a pattern of thoughts and behaviour which certain women develop as a response to problems from childhood.
